scripts.dev: concurrently -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,JARVIS_V2,FRONTEND,PATIENT_MOBILE,WHATSAPP_BOT" -c "cyan,magenta,green,yellow,blue" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix jarvis-v2 run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix patient-mobile run dev" "npm --prefix twilio-whatsapp-bot run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix twilio-whatsapp-bot test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix twilio-whatsapp-bot run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix twilio-whatsapp-bot run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
